BeatO CURV Glucometer
Video description: You’ve probably seen those viral videos- someone drops iodine on paneer, and it turns black.
But is that real proof of adulteration? Or is the test itself flawed?
We collected paneer from street stalls, fast food chains, and dairies across Delhi. Ran iodine tests. Sent samples to labs. Spoke to food scientists.
What we found raises a bigger question: Do we really know what we’re eating?
